Definition: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither
BiblicalUsage: The word is a question — where, whither, how long. The angel asks Hagar whence she came and whither she will go, and David asks the LORD how long He will forget him, and how long He will hide His face. It is the word of someone who does not know where they are or how long the trouble will last, and it is asked straight to God.
TheologicalSignificance: A question word carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the honesty of asking God where, and how long, and trusting Him with the answer.
